title: Allergen labelling for consumers
reuse: The copyright page says material on the website is provided under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, with Food Standards Australia New Zealand named as the source. The logo and third-party material are not covered.
taken: The names in its list of foods and ingredients to be declared, the cereals declared when they contain gluten, and the level from which added sulphites are declared. Product exemptions are on another page, which was not read. The page was last updated on 26 November 2025.
